gate_rule: dual: both instruments must clear 0.95; p_gate = min

instruments.market_source: No dated IPL 2027 outright market this far out (squads not final; mini-auction 16 Dec 2026). Structural model only until a book prices it - every question is therefore WATCH-1INST by design.
instruments.model_note: P(champion) proportional to exp(rating/tau). Rating = a 2026-strength index by final finish (RCB 100 down to LSG 64); tau widened to 40 (vs 8 for internationals) because T20 franchise cricket is extremely high-variance and squads are still unsettled. This deliberately flattens the field - the favourite sits near 15%, not 50%. It is a coarse, provisional prior, NOT a tournament simulation.

quality_flags: Squads are NOT final. The IPL 2027 cycle is a MINI-auction: retention deadline 17 Nov 2026, mini-auction 16 Dec 2026 in Goa, player registration closes 23 Nov. Trades are live now (e.g. Rishabh Pant back to Delhi Capitals from LSG). This is a provisional read that WILL re-run once squads settle.

Because it is a mini-auction (unlimited retentions, no reset, no right-to-match this cycle), 2026 team strength carries over far more than in a mega-auction year - which is why a 2026-standings prior is defensible, but it is still coarse.
Single instrument only: there is no dated IPL 2027 outright betting market this far out, so every question is WATCH-1INST. The engine will NOT certify an IPL winner on one coarse instrument.
T20 franchise cricket is extremely high-variance: the eventual champion is routinely not the league-topper. The win probabilities are deliberately flat - the favourite is near 15%, not a lock.
Model is a championship-share by 2026-strength rating, not a ball-by-ball tournament simulation; no 2027 fixtures or squads are modelled yet.

questions.q: Winner from the 2026 top four (RCB, GT, RR, SRH)

rules: Winner = the franchise that lifts the IPL 2027 trophy per the official result, including a final decided by DLS or a super over
A franchise is identified by its 2027 identity; a rebrand or relocation that the BCCI treats as the same franchise counts as that franchise
Tournament cancelled or not completed with no trophy awarded = VOID, logged and excluded from scoring
resolution.source: The franchise awarded the IPL 2027 trophy per the official BCCI/IPL result (iplt20.com), final expected ~May 2027
